description: Exhaustive list of allowed international editorial exceptions for Iranian cinema. Daily domestic news is strictly rejected.

allowed_exception_categories.name: Major International Awards
allowed_exception_categories.description: Conferral of major competitive awards to Iranian filmmakers/works at premier international venues (e.g. Academy Awards, Cannes Palme d'Or / Grand Prix / Jury Prize, Venice Golden / Silver Lion, Berlinale Golden / Silver Bear, Locarno Golden Leopard).

allowed_exception_categories.name: Major International Festival Official Selection
allowed_exception_categories.description: Inclusion of an Iranian work or filmmaker in Official Competition or major curated sidebar (e.g. Un Certain Regard, Directors' Fortnight) at premier A-list festivals.

allowed_exception_categories.name: Historically Significant International Event
allowed_exception_categories.description: Major international retrospectives at premier cinematheques/museums, major institutional restorations, or international academic symposiums.

allowed_exception_categories.name: Genuine International Cultural Significance
allowed_exception_categories.description: Events involving major international cultural institutions, prominent international co-productions, or major international critical retrospectives.
